title: Update SettingsView with folder picker row
description: Modify CookbookApp/Settings/SettingsView.swift. Replace the disabled Text('Not configured') row in the 'Recipes folder' section with two conditional states driven by RecipesFolderStore: (a) no folder — an enabled Button('Choose folder…') that presents RecipesFolderPicker; (b) folder configured — a row displaying folderName on the leading side and a trailing Button('Change…') that also presents RecipesFolderPicker. Cancellation leaves prior state unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: SettingsView.swift no longer has a disabled 'Not configured' Text row
When RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is nil: enabled 'Choose folder…' Button is shown
When RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is non-nil: row shows folderName leading and 'Change…' button trailing
RecipesFolderStore is accessed via environment or injected parameter — not re-instantiated

handoff_summary.completed: SettingsView.swift updated with conditional folder picker UI. RecipesTab.swift updated to own RecipesFolderStore and pass it to SettingsView. All acceptance criteria satisfied. Build errors in my changed files: none. Pre-existing withSecurityScope error in RecipesFolderStore.swift is unrelated.
handoff_summary.risks: Pre-existing build failure in RecipesFolderStore.swift (withSecurityScope unavailable in iOS) will block the full build. This existed before this bead and is outside scope, but a downstream tester agent will encounter it.
handoff_summary.next_action: Pre-existing RecipesFolderStore.swift build error (withSecurityScope unavailable in iOS) must be resolved before the tester agent can run. Consider a recovery or developer bead to fix or conditionally compile that API.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipesTab.swift was not in expected_files but required a minimal change (add @State store property, update SettingsView call site) to avoid a compile error. Any sibling bead also modifying RecipesTab.swift should be aware of the new store property.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used parameter injection (let store: RecipesFolderStore) rather than @Environment since no environment key exists for RecipesFolderStore in the current codebase. RecipesTab owns the store as @State since it is the root of the sheet hierarchy.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Cancellation is inherently handled: RecipesFolderPicker.Coordinator only calls store.saveBookmark on didPickDocumentsAt — dismissing the picker without selection leaves store unchanged.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: RecipesFolderStore.withSecurityScope is macOS-only and causes a build failure on iOS targets. This is pre-existing and not introduced by this bead.

conflict_risks: RecipesTab.swift was not in expected_files but required a minimal change (add @State store property, update SettingsView call site) to avoid a compile error. Any sibling bead also modifying RecipesTab.swift should be aware of the new store property.

execution_history.summary: Updated SettingsView.swift to replace the disabled 'Not configured' Text row with two conditional states driven by RecipesFolderStore: a 'Choose folder…' Button when folderURL is nil, and a folder-name + 'Change…' Button HStack when a folder is configured. Both buttons present RecipesFolderPicker via a sheet. Also updated RecipesTab.swift to own the RecipesFolderStore as @State and pass it to SettingsView.
